before.supportingExcerpt: Fictional splice-site example: 32 alternate reads among 160 usable reads give VAF 20 per cent. Suppose half the sampled cells are malignant, every cell has two local copies, and each affected cancer cell carries one altered copy, with equal recovery per copy. Then VAF = purity times cancer-cell fraction divided by two; 0.20 = 0.50 times CCF divided by two gives CCF 80 per cent. With pure cancer-cell input, the same 20 per cent fits CCF 40 per cent. These are model calculations, not counted cells. Local copy changes, altered-copy multiplicity, recovery bias or uncertain purity can change the fit. A measured splice junction and functional repair remain separate questions.

TCGA described multiple HER2-amplicon-associated genes, including GRB7, in its breast-cancer analysis. before.supportingExcerpt: Two invented mixtures show why the same fraction can fit different carrier fractions. Each contains 60 cancer and 40 diploid normal cells, with no variant in the normal cells and unbiased recovery. Model A gives every cancer cell two local copies and one variant copy: 60 variant copies among 120 cancer plus 80 normal copies give VAF 30 percent and CCF 100 percent. Model B gives every cancer cell four local copies, with 48 of the 60 cells carrying two variant copies each: 96 among 240 cancer plus 80 normal copies again give VAF 30 percent, but CCF is 80 percent. They match that one fraction; they have not been shown to fit the same complete dataset. Independent copy evidence can distinguish the hypotheses.

before.supportingExcerpt: In a fictional TP53 example, 60 cancer cells each carry one variant copy and have lost the other local copy; 40 normal cells each have two unaltered copies. With equal recovery per copy, the expected variant fraction is 60 divided by 140, about 43 percent. Another model, 86 percent cancer-cell purity with two local copies and one variant copy in every cancer cell, gives 86 divided by 200, exactly 43 percent. Both round to 43 percent when reported to a whole percentage point. That reported fraction alone cannot choose the copy model or establish that a missense variant disables the protein. These are conditional calculations, not a measured clone or a functional test.
before.explanation: The actual TCGA and Shah cohorts are scoped separately from the fictional TP53 calculation. The 60/140 and86/200 alternative models both round to43 percent without establishing missense functional loss, current repair or universal founder status. 22544022: Complete raw abstract read; 5 selected body paragraphs read.
